BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to involving legislators in transportationplanning; amending RCW 47.80.040; and adding a new section to chapter47.80 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.80.040 and 1990 1st ex.s. c 17 s 56 are eachamended to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each regional transportation planning organization shall create atransportation policy board. Transportation policy boards shallprovide policy advice to the regional transportation planningorganization and shall allow representatives of major employers withinthe region, the department of transportation, transit districts, portdistricts, and member cities, towns, and counties within the region toparticipate in policy making. Any members of the house ofrepresentatives or the state senate whose districts are within theboundaries of the regional transportation planning organization areconsidered ex officio, nonvoting policy board members of the regional p. 1 ESB 5245transportation planning organization. This does not precludelegislators from becoming fulltime, voting board members.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.80 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: When voting on matters solely affecting Washington state, aregional transportation planning organization must obtain a majorityvote of the Washington residents serving as members of the regionaltransportation planning organization before a matter may be adopted.
